name: Polymarket BTC market rules card
description: Full-replacement rules card for one automatically bound Polymarket BTC Up/Down market generation. The signal contract accepts validated five- or fifteen-minute Gamma markets; the included automatic lifecycle selects the configured five-minute cadence. strike is the Chainlink BTC/USD 60-second TWAP observation whose event_time equals window_open (opening_strike_source=exact). When that exact-boundary frame has not arrived by window_open + 2 s, the strike falls back to the last frame with event_time <= window_open within 5 s before the open (opening_strike_source=prior_frame), else the first frame with event_time > window_open within 5 s after it (opening_strike_source=post_frame). A fallback strike is an approximation of the venue's exact-boundary Chainlink TWAP, but the market still publishes Ready: opening_strike_source rides the wire on this identity and on every strike-derived Polymarket identity (window_delta, standardized_moneyness, fair_up_probability, executable_edge, expected_value, settlement_anchor_state, tie_rule_context) so a consumer can filter an approximate strike itself. A strike is fixed once per market: a later exact frame never revises a strike already taken. opening_strike_source is always present on a published market. If no frame lies within either window the market stays warming (opening_strike_unavailable) with no strike. settlement_benchmark, comparator, tie_outcome, outcome mapping, rules hash, and venue order constraints are first-class values and must not be treated as equivalent to another venue's benchmark. A market_transition bound frame precedes the first update for a generation, and an unavailable frame plus degraded batch ends it. Decimal values are rounded to at most eight places using round-half-to-even.
